commentary.text: 90+9' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' An infringement by Victor Chust (Elche) results in a yellow card and as it's the second time today, he also sees a red and is dismissed by Francisco Maeso.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alvaro Carreras trots off the pitch and is replaced by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid).
88' Aleix Febas (Elche) picks up a yellow card.

87' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Kylian Mbappe plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 2:2.
84' 2 - 1 Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
83' Eder Sarabia has decided to substitute Marc Aguado and he is replaced by Federico Redondo Solari (Elche).
83' It is time for a substitution. Leo Petrot (Elche) is on for German Valera.
82' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
82' The shots on goal statistics – 5:4.

81' Martim Neto (Elche) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andre Silva departs the field of play to be replaced by Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche).
78' 1 - 1 Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) scores from the corner kick. The ball slipped through the box to Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) and he slotted it past the goalkeeper.
77' The referee awards a corner and Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) goes over to take it.
76' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
76' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
75' Real Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
74' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
73' The attendance for today's match is 31024.
73' Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
72' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
72' Good defending. Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) tries to find Kylian Mbappe inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
71' 8:12 – the total goal attempt statistics.
68' Victor Chust (Elche) receives a yellow card.
68' Although Eder Sarabia (Elche) is just on the bench, Francisco Maeso has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
67' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
66' Here comes a substitution. Martim Neto (Elche) is brought on as a substitute for Grady Diangana.
66' Eder Sarabia prepares a substitution. Hector Fort is replaced by Adria Pedrosa (Elche).

65' Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
64' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Arda Guler walks off the pitch to be replaced by Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid).
64' A pass by German Valera (Elche) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
62' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
61' Neat passing move from Real Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
60' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
60' Ball possession – 48:52.
59' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
57' Here comes a substitution. Dani Ceballos is given a rest as he is replaced by Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid).
57' Xabi Alonso decides to make a substitution. Fran Garcia will be replaced by Federico Valverde (Real Madrid).
57' Substitution. Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) has come on for Rodrygo.
57' David Affengruber (Elche) is awarded a yellow card.
55' The Elche players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
53' 1 - 0 Goal Aleix Febas (Elche)! Aleix Febas (Elche) was put through by German Valera and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
52' Great touch by Aleix Febas (Elche) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!

51' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
50' The Elche players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
49' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) is penalised for a foul. Francisco Maeso had a clear view and blows his whistle.
48' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
48' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) steps up to send the ball in.

47' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the top right corner. Inaki Pena has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
47' German Valera (Elche) dribbles into the box, but Thibaut Courtois is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
46' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is flagged for offside.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
43' Surely that's handball by one of the Elche players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
42' 3:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
41' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
39' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

39' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Real Madrid get a corner.

38' This was a piece of cake for Thibaut Courtois. Andre Silva (Elche) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
36' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
35' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Inaki Pena, who smothers the ball.
34' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
32' Hector Fort (Elche) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
31' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes.
31' The corner is swung in but Real Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
30' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
28' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
28' A pass by Andre Silva (Elche) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
27' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:4.
26' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

24' A wild pass somehow finds Arda Guler (Real Madrid) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
24' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) commits a foul during an attacking move.
23' Elche are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
22' Elche work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

21' What a miss! The corner finds Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
20' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
20' A cross from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Corner kick. Real Madrid will have an opportunity.
17' Rafa Mir (Elche) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Thibaut Courtois.
17' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
16' Grady Diangana (Elche) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
15' Elche control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
13' Andre Silva (Elche) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
13' Referee Francisco Maeso sees the trip by Victor Chust (Elche) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
12' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Real Madrid.

11' A short pass finds Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
10' The ball is cleared after Arda Guler (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' The ratio of the ball possession is 55:45.
8' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Aleix Febas (Elche), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
6' Real Madrid enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
5' Elche quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

4' What a chance that is! Rodrygo (Real Madrid) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
3' Great teamplay by Elche as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is adjudged offside.
1' The first half has just begun.
